newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND TO LOSE SOUSA UNTIL FEBRUARY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND TO LOSE SOUSA UNTIL FEBRUARY.

text.p: German champions Borussia Dortmund will be without Paulo Sousa until February after the Portuguese international midfielder opted for an operation on an injured knee.
Sousa, who moved from European champions Juventus for $4.6 million in the close season, has managed only three short outings for Dortmund.
He will be operated on in Paris on Thursday and will not play again until the German league returns in February from its winter break, the club said.
